ai_summary: Alkem Laboratories Limited has received a US FDA warning letter for its Amaliya, Daman manufacturing facility, an escalation from its previously classified "Official Action Indicated (OAI)" status. While the company states there is no material impact on current operations or financials and they continue to supply approved products to the U.S. market, a warning letter is a significant regulatory red flag that typically requires substantial corrective actions and could pose future risks to product approvals and sales if deficiencies are not adequately addressed.
